name: dependency-run-by-git-hook
description: A file below .husky or .githooks is read as a workflow step's run command is, up to a shell comment, and so are the run commands of a lefthook file and the entry commands of .pre-commit-config.yaml, so a dependency whose command a git hook runs is needed and one whose command no hook, script or workflow runs, only a hook's comment naming it, is reported.
